title: Finite reaction gates yield a censored next-event law in the source model
status_authority: Exact selected source bytes and scoped source reports are preserved. This incremental integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority, or practical advantage.
reported_status: The P3 report describes a finite rule-gated event-law construction using local continuous-time Markov modules and a residual certificate. The report acknowledges prior renewal and gated-reaction work. Three actual scripts were retrieved later, but they were not executed here and do not establish the historical identity or execution of the earlier report.
scientific_scope_status: For the source's finite gate program, local-module CTMCs, reset and substrate-depletion model, the reported construction returns the next-event distribution including a censored no-event outcome by the horizon and addresses repeated resets and a rare event. The report includes an 80-binary-site example with 2^80 nominal states. This is a source-reported finite class, not a general reaction-event solution or novelty claim.
